name: Assyrians
description: A white field with a four-pointed blue star around a golden disc at the centre, wavy red, white and blue rays reaching to the four corners, and the winged figure of the god Ashur above.
history: The Assyrian flag was designed in 1968 by George Bit Atanus and adopted by the Assyrian Universal Alliance in 1971; the wavy rays represent the rivers of the Assyrian homeland — the Tigris, the Euphrates and the Zab — and the winged disc above bears Ashur, the chief deity of ancient Assyria.

features.role: four-pointed star around a golden disc

features.symbolism: the Tigris, the Euphrates and the Zab

features.role: winged disc bearing the god Ashur
